notes.title: Coming soon: Free Update - Gallery Mode
notes.notes:
Hello All, we hope you are doing well! 

Due to popular player feedback, we are happy to announce that a gallery mode will be implemented soon into the game at no additional cost.

We apologise for the delay and as always, we appreciate all those who have purchased the game and all our supporters. We plan on releasing more free content so please keep an eye out for that. Until next time!


Koi Spirit Team
